unpriced: site-specific elevated conversion and clearance premiums

financial_scope: Partial fleet and ordinary elevated civil allowances; complete installed programme unknown

gates.closure: Survey, utilities, land, water crossings, terrain, ground investigation and alignment reconciliation; retained mapping is geographic evidence only.

Close coupling pitch, full magnetic lifting-face/guidance-arm/below-floor swept envelope, door/egress layouts, actual mass and equal AW2/AW3 qualification. The 2.65 m cabin width does not bound running gear or platform clearance.
Obtain force/loss maps and rig correlation, six-axis stability, target timing and independent support/capture/braking protection.
Locate fixed loops/ring closure, qualify curvature, clearance and land, and provide switch-free failure recovery.

Locate the predominantly elevated straight-tangent proposal and verify buildings/air rights, road/utility clearance, wildlife/water passage, piers, station/egress and construction access; no zero-impact claim from elevation alone.
Redesign guidebeam/passive rail, supports/foundations, joints/tolerances, movement, gap dynamics, evacuation and erection.
Run approved grade, curve, wind, hot, low-voltage, full-SOC, no-regen, missed-charge, failed-channel and rescue duty.
Validate headway/conflicts, station berth throughput, dispatch, maintenance rotation, degraded service and reserve.
Place charging interfaces and prove taper, power quality, PV/storage/backup sizing and adverse-weather replenishment.
Locate line-local storage/workshops and qualify depot-only connection/transfer, isolation, inspection, towing and recovery.
Price all station/land/loop/bridge/at-grade/depot/energy/control/production/QA/NRE/spares/OPEX scope, origin-trace MBOM and apply EPC once.
Close G0–G5 through authenticated independent physical acceptance; planning arithmetic is insufficient.

depot.access: A moving transfer device or engineered depot-only connection is required and unqualified.

exclusions: loop lateral force and physical geometry
charger taper/grid and battery internal losses

fleet.rule: ceil(hot/no-regen circuit time / retained peak headway), two directions for rings, 10% spare rounded up plus one cold reserve/line

formation.envelope_basis: Cabin width does not bound magnetic lifting faces, guidance arms or below-floor gear. Revalidate full route/platform swept envelope against native geometry.
formation.length_basis: Sum of nominal 17 m bodies; coupling pitch and overhang unresolved.

exclusive_shuttle_alternative.rule: One train per isolated bidirectional lane; no passing or crossover. This lane count is a capacity screen, not a selected civil plan.
